record.question:
Match the following:
Epithets: A. Sugar Bowl of the World, B. Land of Lilies, C. Land of Thunderbolt, D. Britain of the South
Country: 1. New Zealand, 2. Cuba, 3. Canada, 4. Bhutan
record.explanation: Answer B: A-2, B-3, C-4, D-1. Using the conventional epithet matches in the Kerala PSC table: Cuba is “Sugar Bowl of the World” (2), Canada “Land of Lilies” (3), Bhutan “Land of the Thunderbolt” (4), and New Zealand “Britain of the South” (1). That yields option (b), index 1. These are conventional nicknames, not formal designations. Reference: https://www.keralapsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/nov-01-2018.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
